scenarios.name: Hardwood Deck Estimator to Quote Delivery

scenarios.prompt: Hi, I'm planning to build a hardwood deck of 5x3 meters
messages: Hi, I'm planning to build a hardwood deck of 5x3 meters
Generate the quote for this deck project

assertions.description: Deck dimensions fact must be extracted
Quote generated fact must be produced by trade.quote_create
